rules: A feature passes only when its acceptance test exists and `make check` is green. Change only the `passes` field; never edit a description or acceptance criteria to make a feature pass.

features.description: Repository skeleton: Go module with govulncheck, benchstat and gremlins pinned as go.mod tools; Makefile quality gates; .golangci.yml; the CI system in docs/ci.md (ci, security, codeql, scorecard, weekly, release, verify-release, data-watch, claude-config); .goreleaser.yaml; Dependabot; the one-time GitHub setup.
features.acceptance: On the first pull request every workflow runs green and CI passed is the required check; actionlint and zizmor (auditor persona) report no findings; a snapshot release builds reproducibly; the lint rules reject a deliberate violation of each rule.

features.description: internal/safeio: size-limited file reading that refuses to follow symlinks outside the scan roots.
features.acceptance: TestSafeIOLimits and TestSafeIOSymlinkEscape pass; FuzzSafeIORead runs for 60 seconds without failures.

features.description: Inventory npm packages from lockfiles and installed node_modules through OSV-SCALIBR.
features.acceptance: TestInventoryNpm finds every package in testdata/fixtures/npm-project/ and nothing else.

features.description: Inventory Python packages from lockfiles and installed environments through OSV-SCALIBR.
features.acceptance: TestInventoryPyPI finds every package in testdata/fixtures/python-project/.

features.description: Inventory editor extensions for VS Code, Cursor and Windsurf.
features.acceptance: TestInventoryExtensions lists every extension in testdata/fixtures/editors/.

features.description: Inventory MCP server configurations for Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor and Windsurf.
features.acceptance: TestInventoryMCP lists every server in testdata/fixtures/mcp-configs/ with its command and source file.

features.description: Local SQLite store for inventory and findings, readable only by the user.
features.acceptance: TestStoreRoundTrip passes; TestStorePermissions confirms the database file is user-only.

features.description: Download the signed data file and verify its Sigstore signature, signing identity and freshness; refuse older files.
features.acceptance: TestDataVerify accepts the valid test vector and rejects tampered, wrongly signed and older files.

features.description: Match the inventory against the malicious-package index.
features.acceptance: TestMatchMalicious flags the known-malicious versions in testdata/fixtures/infected-npm/ and nothing in testdata/fixtures/clean/.

features.description: Match the inventory against OSV records for CVEs in CISA KEV.
features.acceptance: TestMatchExploited flags the exploited versions in testdata/fixtures/kev-project/.

features.description: Re-match new threat data against the stored inventory without scanning the disk.
features.acceptance: TestRetroactiveAlert: a package installed before its report appears is flagged after a data update, with no file reads.

features.description: First campaign pack (Mini Shai-Hulud) and its replay fixture.
features.acceptance: TestReplay/mini-shai-hulud fires on its fixture and stays quiet on testdata/fixtures/clean/.

features.description: `affectd scan` prints findings grouped by severity, with a documented JSON output.
features.acceptance: TestCLIReportGolden matches the golden text and JSON outputs for testdata/fixtures/infected-npm/.

features.description: Local API from proto/: list findings over a user-only socket.
features.acceptance: TestLocalAPIListFindings passes; TestLocalAPISocketPermissions confirms only the user can connect.

features.description: Benchmarks for matching, re-matching and large-lockfile inventory, with the budgets from .claude/rules/matching.md.
features.acceptance: BenchmarkMatch, BenchmarkRematch and BenchmarkInventoryNpmLarge exist; a budget test (skipped with -short) fails if matching 10,000 packages against a 250,000-entry index exceeds 50 ms or the index exceeds 100 MB; CI posts a benchstat comparison on every pull request.
